dct_title_s: Landslides impact analysis in Melamchi Municipality, Bagmati province, Nepal as of 24 June 2021
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20210630NPL** This map illustrates satellite-detected flash floods and landslides in Melamchi village, Melamchi Municipality, Bagmati province, Nepal as observed using Sentinel-2 satellite imagery acquired on 24 June 2021. Within the analyzed area, approximately 150 structures appear to be potentially affected by the landslides. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
